tagline: The trade-credit desk that learns from its decisions

zetaris.role: Single data layer: 32 Lightning REST tables straight to data.sec.gov (8 customers x 4 XBRL concepts) plus the seller's 4 systems, all CACHE TABLE'd, flattened into 8 SchemaStore views; federated joins (ERP x SEC revenue, assets x liabilities, ledger x customer master). Every decision cites Zetaris query ids.

scout_intent.role: Intake: registry, lexical scoring, Guard (injection, forbidden actions, unverified authority claims), HMAC-signed ExecutionContract carrying the desk's authority; verified before every query and every desk change; refreshed per Markovian step

hmem.role: Decision and outcome memory with provenance (decision id + Zetaris query ids); recalled per account before underwriting

world_model.role: Case file: accounts, policy conditions, decisions evidenced_by queries, execution facts; single-writer queue

markovian.role: Portfolio review in bounded steps of two accounts; carryover = exposure ledger for POL-11

runtime.role: Nightshift is the primary AI provider (Meterless Runtime 0.90.0 contract)

meterless.tests: npm test (8 Terms feature tests + 30 engine conformance tests)

nvidia.role: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B underwrites every account (deep lane); Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B binds request parameters (fast lane); served by Nightshift

sponsor_technology.coding_tool: Claude Code (Cursor became optional on Oct 22)

data.public: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts (real, live via Zetaris)
data.simulated: Halden Packaging seller ledger (scripts/gen-ledger.ts); Halden is fictional
